description: LPOS v4.8.1 lean managed-execution release: bounded exact-specialist execution in an exact Git worktree, risk-tier tool allowlists, preserved-receipt preflight, deterministic checks, strict machine-readable receipts, hash-bound independent review, and at most two consolidated correction cycles. This patch removes 4 ceremony skills (quality-router, system-auditor, test-evidence-auditor, acceptance-spec-reviewer) and fixes managed-execution source_snapshot to exclude generated artifacts, public/, node_modules/, state/, .hermes/, and .lpos-managed/ so reviews no longer fail on non-source files. The frozen 4.7 expert corpus and all prior authority, evidence, security, record-only external-action, and rollback controls are preserved.
name: LPOS
